direct_reply_pairs.response_scope: 1174 is the reply letter: P1–5 respond to Indian observations and P9 to chest symptoms; P6–8 also add independent work, family and other correspondence. No claim that every statement derives from 1158.
direct_reply_pairs.response_date_policy: Use the outgoing letter date with its original supplied components; incoming composition sections remain separate. Known-by is not a physical receipt date.
direct_reply_pairs.rationale: Long-letter acknowledgment plus distinctive disputed fertility of wild/domestic Bhil, zoological uncertainty and continuing chest symptoms identifies this composite input; no single-day composition or receipt is invented.
